title: 27. Execution Integrity System (EIS)
summary: Defines the Execution Integrity System subsystem for verifying distributed computation honesty through execution contracts, determinism classes, checkpoint-band matching, and teacher-forced spot-check protocols.
notes: Document sits in docs/architecture/ with no PRD/ADR/SPEC path signals. Has 'Status: Draft for review' frontmatter suggesting ADR lineage but lacks Context/Decision/Consequences structure. Content defines technical implementation contracts (determinism classes A/B/C, checkpoint-band comparison domains, teacher-forced protocol steps, execution contract field requirements) that systems must honor -- these are SPEC-level constraints. Classified SPEC over DOC because the technical contract definitions carry more weight than the prose-heavy architecture exposition. Confidence medium due to mixed signals.
